name: neant
description: Syntax highlighting for neant, and the compiler's inferred cost of every function as grey text next to its signature.

neant.path.description: The neant compiler: a name on PATH, or a path to bootstrap/target/debug/neant. A relative path is taken from the workspace folder.

neant.mode.description: `lsp`: run `neant lsp`, the compiler as a Language Server, for diagnostics, grey text, hovers and go-to-definition. `hints`: the fallback, run `neant hints` on open, save and pause (no go-to-definition). Takes effect on reload.

neant.args.description: Extra arguments to `neant lsp` or `neant hints`, e.g. ["-M", "32768", "-B", "64"] for another cache.

neant.hints.style.description: How each function's cost is shown: grey text after the `fn` line, a VS Code inlay hint there, or not at all (diagnostics are still reported).

neant.hints.debounceMs.description: After an edit, wait this long without another before the unsaved buffer is analysed (sent to `neant lsp`, or run through `neant hints --stdin`); with `hints`, 0 runs only on open and save.

neant.hints.maxLength.description: Longest grey text shown on the line; the full report is in the hover.

neant.unknownsAsDiagnostics.description: Report where each unknown cost comes from as a hint-level diagnostic at the line the report names.

neant.timeoutMs.description: How long `neant hints` may run on one file.
